metadata.description: Dev.-DBs-Skills: agent skills for software architecture, engineering fundamentals, security and databases, one plugin per category.

plugins.name: dev-dbs-all
plugins.description: Every skill of the pack, all categories.

plugins.name: dev-dbs-architecture
plugins.description: Architectural styles and design: hexagonal, clean, layered, modular monolith, microservices, event-driven, CQRS, sagas and more.

plugins.name: dev-dbs-components
plugins.description: Software components: routing, gateways, middleware, caching, workers, rate limiting, auth guards, repositories, validators, feature flags, state machines, email.

plugins.name: dev-dbs-principles
plugins.description: Fundamental principles in depth: SSOT and DRY, SRP, OCP, dependency inversion, KISS/YAGNI, value objects, error handling.

plugins.name: dev-dbs-cloud-native-ai
plugins.description: Cloud-native, resilience, evolution and AI agents: 12-factor, circuit breakers, agentic RAG, context and harness engineering, multi-agent coordination, skill creation.

plugins.name: dev-dbs-documentation
plugins.description: Documentation, diagrams and contracts: ADRs, arc42 with OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, C4, Diataxis, Mermaid.

plugins.name: dev-dbs-workflow-mattpocock
plugins.description: Engineering workflow from Matt Pocock's MIT pack: grilling, spec, tickets, implement, TDD, triage, handoff and more.

plugins.name: dev-dbs-engineering-security
plugins.description: Engineering fundamentals and security: audits, code review, testing, performance, dependencies, supply chain, vulnerability triage, threat modeling.

plugins.name: dev-dbs-databases
plugins.description: Databases and governance: schema, migrations, query performance, exposure, cost, backups, SQL Server audit.

plugins.name: dev-dbs-database-diagnostics
plugins.description: Read-only diagnostic query packs for PostgreSQL, SQL Server and SQLite in production.
